verdict.rationale: Mercury documents that receipts emailed or uploaded are automatically matched and attached to the right card transaction. It also mentions AI-powered accounting automations and offers a receipt-upload agent skill. However, the user still has to forward or upload each receipt, and nothing shows receipts being captured at the moment of card use or transactions being auto-coded to accounting categories. Missing for 10: automatic receipt capture triggered at card swipe without user action, documented automatic GL/category coding of card transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have receipts automatically captured and coded the moment a card is used, without manual entry

citations.quote: Email or upload receipts and we’ll auto-attach them to the right card transaction. You don’t lift a finger.
save hours with AI-powered automations to close your books faster
